data.rationale: The proposal follows the true path in the right order (Menu, Agencies, Bridges & Tunnels, Tolls by vehicle, then the vehicle tile) and correctly makes vehicle type a parameter, but it leaves out the facility parameter and its "or" alternatives make the spec less exact to automate.
